name: Brewmeister Bilger
summary: Brewmeister Bilger is an intoxicated dwarven brewer residing in the cellar of the inn at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He whiles away his hours tasting potent spirits and waiting on deliveries from distant lands.

sections.title: Life in the Cellar
sections.body: Bilger spends his days pacing the cool cellar beneath Southshore's inn, nursing hiccups and seeking out the strongest brews Azeroth can offer.

sections.title: A Taste for Potent Imports
sections.body: Despite his perpetual stupor, Bilger remains a discerning judge of spirits. He maintains an appetite for heavy dwarven moonshines and potent liquors crafted in the south, eagerly receiving special batches like the moonshine Foggy MacKreel sends him from the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Where can I find Brewmeister Bilger?
faq.answer: Brewmeister Bilger is located downstairs in the cellar of the inn at Southshore, the Alliance port town in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Bilger is the recipient of rare liquor delivered from the Wetlands, including strong spirits like MacKreel's Moonshine shipped north to Southshore.

angles.text: Bilger shows that the dwarven love of strong drink thrives even in a human port town far from Ironforge.
A fixture of Southshore's inn cellar, Bilger is one of the dwarves who make their home among the humans of this beleaguered Alliance town.
